newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BAYERN DEFENDER KREUZER MOVES TO BASLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYERN DEFENDER KREUZER MOVES TO BASLE.

text.p: Bayern Munich defender Oliver Kreuzer said on Tuesday he was moving to Swiss first division club Basle at the end of the season on a four-year contract.
The fee was believed to be around 800,000 marks ($475,000).

Kreuzer, 32, has struggled to hold down a regular place in the league leaders' defence this season but had rejected offers from English premier league Newcastle and German second division Hertha Berlin. ($ = 1.675 German Marks)
